outlook.nextStep: Broadcom's Q3 report lands after today's close and is probably the single most consequential near-term catalyst for the AI-infrastructure trade — worth watching closely rather than acting on ahead of the print. The climbing Fed rate-hike odds and their spillover into gold, crypto, and richly-valued growth names are a broader theme worth a closer look for signs of whether the pressure eases or builds into the September 15-16 meeting.

signals.title: Fed rate-hike odds climb toward 70% on hawkish commentary
signals.body: Market-implied odds of a 25-basis-point September hike rose to roughly 70% after hawkish Fed commentary, pushing the 10-year yield to a fresh high since January 2025 and firming up the dollar. Gold slipped below $4,400 and richly-valued growth stocks stayed under pressure as a result.
signals.focus: probably better watched than acted on until the September 15-16 FOMC meeting provides more clarity

signals.title: Strait of Hormuz tensions keep oil elevated into a second session
signals.body: WTI extended its climb to around $91 a barrel as the fallout from this week's tanker strikes near the Strait of Hormuz continued to ripple through energy markets, adding further inflation pressure just as the Fed weighs its next move.
signals.focus: a genuine escalation risk worth watching closely for further headlines before drawing conclusions either way

signals.title: Broadcom's Q3 report lands after today's close
signals.body: Wall Street consensus looks for roughly $29.4B in revenue (+84% YoY) and strong AI semiconductor growth. Whether management raises 2027 AI guidance is seen as the key swing factor for the stock's reaction, with shares trading in a tight range ahead of the print.
signals.focus: worth watching closely tonight and tomorrow morning rather than positioning ahead of the print

signals.title: Chip sector broadly lower as memory and AI-infra names lead declines
signals.body: Nvidia, AMD, and Micron all traded lower as the risk-off tone from elevated oil prices and rising yields weighed on the chip complex for a second straight session, while Taiwan Semiconductor and Arm held up relatively better.
signals.focus: worth watching whether this is a routine pullback or the start of something more persistent

signals.title: Tesla's robotaxi event tomorrow is the sector's key near-term catalyst
signals.body: Investors are positioning ahead of Tesla's September 3 robotaxi event, expected to center on a Cybercab reveal and updates on Optimus mass-production plans, with Nevada regulators having already approved up to 5,000 autonomous vehicles in the network's first year.
signals.focus: worth a closer look given the binary nature of event-driven catalysts like this one

signals.title: Zscaler pulls back heading into tomorrow's earnings report
signals.body: Zscaler shares eased ahead of its September 3 print even as the broader cybersecurity group remains well-bid following CrowdStrike's blowout Q2 and last week's strong sector-wide re-rating.
signals.focus: worth watching whether the pullback is pre-earnings positioning or a genuine shift in sentiment

signals.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum extend their pullback as hike odds climb
signals.body: Both cryptocurrencies fell further as the same hawkish Fed repricing that pressured gold and growth stocks also weighed on crypto, with Bitcoin dipping below $77K and Ethereum below $2,450.
signals.focus: worth watching whether this pause turns into a deeper pullback if Fed hike odds keep climbing into the September meeting
